newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's CDC leaves Q2 growth forecast at 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: France's CDC leaves Q2 growth forecast at 0.7 pct.

text.p: France's gross domestic product (GDP) should show 0.7 percent growth during the second quarter, French state bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) said on Monday.
The second quarter forecast based on seasonally and calendar adjusted data was unrevised from the CDC's earlier estimate.
It revised upward its forecast for third quarter growth to 0.6 percent from 0.5 percent and said external demand remained the main factor behind economic activity.
It said in June imports declined while exports rose, partly because of the dollar's sharp appreciation against the franc.
The slightly slower growth projected for the third quarter compared with the second quarter was a result of negative sentiment reflected in confidence polls in May and June, it said.

CDC said the general outlook had declined during these two months but positive aspects persisted, namely external demand along with stock market and interest rate spreads which were favourable for second and third quarter growth.
